headline: Scores flat; new niches debut at smart-home 84, career 75, cyber 58
paragraphs: Opportunity scores were flat: 54 of 55 niches tracked yesterday did not move, and horror-stories slipped 78 to 77. First scores for yesterday's additions: smart-home-reviews 84 (82% breakout rate), career-resume-tips 75 (49%), cybersecurity-tips 58 (29%).

Top new breakouts: Resume Genius's Short "When Millennial managers have to communicate with Gen Zs:", 1012.4x its channel's typical views (2,974,410 views, 22,800 subscribers), and Licky's Smart Home Channel's SAMDUO Nex E6000 unboxing Short, 379x (491,507 views, 20,600 subscribers).

Added two niches to track: trading-app-tutorials and vintage-album-music, from OutlierKit's June 2026 untapped-niche list, not this week's data. Thumbnails did not load, so there are 5 channel entries (1 faceless, 1 not, 3 non-English), no thumbnail tags, and titles-only niche notes.
